# Smogon University

> Smogon University is the premier competitive Pokémon community providing strategy guides, metagame analysis, and tournament organization across all game generations.

Founded as a hub for competitive Pokémon battling, Smogon University hosts extensive strategy resources, community forums, and official tournaments. The site maintains comprehensive guides for each generation's competitive metagame and operates Pokémon Showdown, the primary platform for online competitive play.

## Key Topics

- Competitive Pokémon
- Pokémon Showdown
- Tournament Organization
- Strategy Guides
- Metagame Analysis
- Pokémon Tiers
- Battling Strategy
- Game Mechanics
- Community Forums
- Smogon Premier League
- Official Smogon Tournament
- Pokémon Types
- Competitive Battling
- Generation Strategy

## Community Hub

- [Smogon University - Competitive Pokémon Community](https://www.smogon.com): Smogon's main hub for competitive Pokémon strategy, guides, and community.
- [Smogon Forums](https://www.smogon.com/forums): Central forum community hub for Smogon discussion and announcements.
- [About Smogon - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/about): History and overview of Smogon University's competitive Pokémon resources.

## Tournaments & Competitive Events

- [Tournaments | Smogon Forums](https://www.smogon.com/forums/forums/tournaments.34): Official Smogon tournament hub for competitive Pokémon events.

## Strategy Guides & Learning

- [Articles - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/articles): Archive of strategy guides and competitive Pokémon articles.
- [Battling 101 | Smogon Forums](https://www.smogon.com/forums/forums/battling-101.42): Beginner tutoring program for competitive Pokémon battling skills.
- [In-Game Articles - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/ingame): Guides for breeding, training, and in-game Pokémon strategy.
- [The Smog community web-zine - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/smog): Community magazine featuring Pokémon strategy and competitive articles.

## Generation-Specific Metagames

- [XY - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/xy): Strategy reference for Pokémon X and Y competitive metagame.
- [Black/White - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/bw): Strategy reference for Pokémon Black and White competitive battling.
- [Diamond/Pearl - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/dp): Strategy reference for Pokémon Diamond and Pearl competitive formats.
- [Ruby/Sapphire - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/rs): Strategy reference for Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire competitive play.
- [Gold/Silver - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/gs): Strategy reference for Pokémon Gold and Silver competitive battling.
- [Red/Blue - Smogon University](https://www.smogon.com/rb): Strategy reference for Pokémon Red and Blue competitive formats.

## Community Projects & Resources

- [Create-A-Pokemon Project | Smogon Forums](https://www.smogon.com/forums/forums/66): Community project for designing and playtesting original Pokémon.
- [Wi-Fi | Smogon Forums](https://www.smogon.com/forums/forums/wi-fi.53): Community forum for Wi-Fi trading, breeding, and Pokémon resources.
